articles.title: The Latest: US and Iran trade strikes as hopes dim for a quick resolution
articles.description: Back-and-and-forth missile strikes between the U.S. and Iran are dimming hopes for a deal to end the war as more countries are drawn in. Jordan, Kuwait, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and Iraq have reported strikes. President Donald Trump's move to install his lawyer Todd Blanche as attorney general is stalled as Republicans object to the Trump tax amnesty deal Blanche engineered. And Trump's approval rating has dropped, with most Americans saying the Iran war isn't worth fighting, according to a new AP-NORC poll. More than 70% say it's highly important to reach a ceasefire and prevent oil and gas prices from rising.
